question: Which of the following statements for the reaction of copper oxide with HCl is correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CuCl2 is formed.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Copper oxide (CuO) reacts with hydrochloric acid (HCl) to form** copper chloride** (CuCl2) and water (H2O).
 
• The balanced chemical equation for this reaction is: **CuO+2HCl→CuCl₂​+H₂​O**
 
• Copper chloride is a **soluble salt** that forms a blue-green solution in water.
 
• This reaction is an example of a** neutralization reaction** where a base (CuO) reacts with an acid (HCl) to form a salt (CuCl2) and water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Copper Sulfate (CuSO₄)**

Typically found as a bright blue crystalline solid in its pentahydrate form (CuSO₄·5H₂O).

 
• Used as a** fungicide and herbicide.**
 
• Utilized in water treatment to control algae growth.
 
• Highly soluble in water.

**Copper (Cu)**

Reddish-brown metal with high electrical and thermal conductivity.

 
• Electrical Wiring
 
• Forms important alloys like** bronze (with tin) and brass **(with zinc).
 
• Reacts with oxygen to form copper oxide but is relatively resistant to corrosion.

**Chlorine Gas (Cl₂)**

Greenish-yellow gas with a pungent odor.

 
• Used to disinfect drinking water and swimming pools.
 
• Bleaching Agent: Employed in the **production of paper and textiles.**
 
• Essential in the production of PVC and other chemicals.
 
• Highly reactive, especially with metals to form chlorides
